title: Sr Software Engineer
description:

We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of the electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.

Renesas is a global, multi-billion dollar; publicly-traded company headquartered in Japan, and has subsidiaries in 20 countries worldwide. Renesas is a dynamic, multi-cultural technology company where employees learn, mentor, innovate and thrive. Renesas is extending our share in fast-growing data economy-related markets such as infrastructure and data center, and strengthening our presence in the industrial/IOT and automotive segments. Our solutions drive products developed by major innovators around the world. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics.

**Job Description**

The software team is seeking a Sr SW Engineer who is technically savvy and is excited about working within a SoC development team to produce customer facing software to enable our customers. This position involves a wide range of challenges from interfacing with IC, firmware designers, Renesas internal cloud infrastructure team, product definition team and other stake holders. As part of one of Renesas’s fastest growing product lines, you will have the opportunity to directly impact customer experience through work on software products that enable feature rich hardware to shine. If you like problem-solving, working with systems involving SW/HW, and switching between multiple languages and paradigms, we’d like to hear from you. If you seek a place to shine with no artificial barriers apply now!

**Responsibilities**
**:**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain software that meets the needs of both customers and internal teams
* Drive clarity on software requirements from diverse groups including application engineers, hardware, firmware engineers
* Contribute to both existing and new projects, covering a broad range of languages and scope. We use Java, Kotlin and Python.
* Aid in code reviews for fellow team members, as required

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering
* 2 to 7 years of software development experience
* Technical expertise in Java, Kotlin programming languages
* Assist in the upkeep of code quality, reusability, and continual code evaluation
* Ability to design, develop, and troubleshoot software solutions using creative, unconventional approaches
* Strong understanding of Software Architecture and Design principles, Behavior-Driven Development and unit testing
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work across teams.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience with Generative and Agentic AI for software development.
* Experience working with JavaScript, JavaFX or GUI development
* Understanding of DevOps including JIRA, Confluence and GitLab preferred
* Understanding of basic electronics, microcontroller programming and bus communication

**Additional Information**

Renesas Electronics Corporation (TSE: 6723) empowers a safer, smarter and more sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. A leading global provider of microcontrollers, Renesas combines our expertise in embedded processing, analog, power and connectivity to deliver complete semiconductor solutions. These Winning Combinations accelerate time to market for automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT applications, enabling billions of connected, intelligent devices that enhance the way people work and live. Learn more at renesas.com. Follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, and Instagram.

Renesas’ mission, To Make Our Lives Easier, is underpinned by our company culture, TAGIE. TAGIE stands for Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative and Entrepreneurial. Our goal is to embed this unique culture in everything we do to succeed as a company and create trust with our diverse colleagues, customers and stakeholders.

We are committed to creating a diverse culture where everyone is included and feels a sense of belonging. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose,
**To Make Our Lives Easier**
. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

description:

* Works in collaboration with software architects, developers, and firmware teams to develop elegant engineering software solutions and applications.

* Proficiency in designing RESTful APIs, API versioning, and secure APIs using OAuth2/JWT.

* Exposure to security best practices and compliance standards.
* Experience with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch).

* Communication: Effectively conveying complex concepts to diverse audiences, including stakeholders, and ensuring clear understanding of project requirements.

description:

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.
  
  
We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. Join a dynamic and collaborative engineering team at Dexcom, a leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). title: React Native Developer
description:
**Must Have**

* 3 to 5 years shipping React Native apps that are live on the Play Store or App Store.
* A consumer app you helped grow past 100K active users, where crashes, slow screens and checkout drop-off had a measurable cost and you were the one who brought them down.
* Strong TypeScript and a deep grip on React Native: the new architecture, native modules, Reanimated and gestures, navigation, and profiling on real devices. You can explain why a screen is slow and fix it.
* A BFF (backend-for-frontend) layer and server-driven UI you have built or consumed in production. This is a big one: it is how we change screens and offers without a release.
* Observability and event SDKs wired properly: product analytics and session replay (PostHog or similar), crash reporting (Crashlytics or Sentry), and marketing and attribution SDKs such as MoEngage and the Meta SDK, with a clean event taxonomy that growth and ops can trust.
* Expo and EAS, or an equivalent build, release and OTA pipeline.
* Automated testing as part of the feature, not after it: Jest, React Native Testing Library, and Maestro or Detox on real devices.
* Strong UI/UX sense and real empathy. You can design a flow when there is no mock, and you understand that someone ordering medicine is often anxious, in a hurry, or not fluent with phones. Confusion here is not a bug, it is a missed dose.
* Inclusive design you can show: apps built for elderly, low-literacy or first-time smartphone users, and the accessibility and readability choices you made.
* Performance-tier engineering: an app that adapts to low-end devices and slow networks, and the measurements you used to segment it.
* Comfort going native when needed: Kotlin for Android modules, logcat and the profiler.
* AI coding assistants in daily use, and proof they made you faster without lowering what you ship.
* Taste. Strong opinions about what a good mobile experience feels like, and a shipped app that shows them.
* Ownership. You've carried a product from design through launch through the production incident afterwards, without a QA team to hand it to.

**Preferred**

* Quick-commerce, healthcare, fintech or any consumer app where the first order and the repeat order were the metrics that mattered.
* Push and in-app campaign tooling beyond the SDK install: journeys, segments and deep links that land on the right screen.
* Firebase (Remote Config, Crashlytics, Realtime Database) and a cloud platform (AWS preferred).
* Hardware-adjacent mobile work: camera and barcode scanning, background location, foreground services.
* Swift and iOS experience, for when the app crosses over.
* Startup or product-company experience where you were one of a handful of engineers.

**Who You Are**

* **High agency.**
  You see a problem, you own it, and you tell people what you did rather than asking whether you may start.
* **Taste.**
  You can tell the difference between an app that works and an app that feels right, and you care enough to close the gap.
* **Empathy.**
  You picture the person on the other side of the screen, and you know that for medicines the stakes are higher than for groceries.
* **All users, not the median one.**
  The 60-year-old on a budget phone with poor eyesight is your benchmark, not an edge case.
* **Bias to delete.**
  You'd rather remove a screen than add a setting. Simplicity is a feature you fight for.
* **Ship, then watch.**
  Replays, crash logs and a chat with a customer tell you more than a sprint review.
* **Whole-surface owner.**
  Happiest in a small team where the app is yours, and comfortable in the backend or native code when it needs you.
* **AI-native, still accountable.**
  You use AI tools to move faster, and you still read every line that goes out under your name.
* **Close to the stores.**
  You enjoy a fast pace and a 6-day week in the office, because the stores run every day and you want to be near them.

**What You'll Get**

* Health insurance for you and your family.
* A top-of-the-line device and the tools you need to do your best work.
* ESOPs: own a piece of the company you're helping build.
* Real users, every day: the people using your app sit a short ride away, and you'll meet them

description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. By leveraging big data platforms like Hadoop and Athena, you will design scalable hunting logic and automated pipelines to defend our global footprint and enhance threat visibility.
